I added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

2. **`entries_since(since)`**: Returns all entries posted at or after the given datetime, sorted by `posted_at` in ascending order (oldest first), using a simple filter and sort.

Both methods follow the existing code patterns and maintain compatibility with the existing timezone-aware UTC constraint documented in the code. All existing tests continue to pass.
